name: Santa Monica Place
description: Santa Monica Place is a premier open-air shopping destination located in the heart of downtown Santa Monica, just blocks from the famous Santa Monica Pier and beach. This upscale lifestyle center features high-end retailers, popular dining options, and a stunning rooftop dining deck with ocean views. Originally opened in 1980 and completely reimagined in 2010, the center combines Southern California's indoor-outdoor lifestyle with luxury shopping and entertainment experiences.
demographics: Affluent coastal demographic with high household incomes, mixed residential and tourist population, strong appeal to fashion-conscious and entertainment-seeking visitors
summary: An upscale open-air lifestyle center in downtown Santa Monica featuring luxury retailers, renowned dining, and a scenic rooftop deck overlooking the Pacific Ocean.
